messages:
Maya (CS): Tideflow submitted a vendor risk form asking for EU-only hosting, BYOK, 90-day embeddings retention, and a 30-day deletion SLA. Need quick triage before tomorrow's call.

Diego (Onboarding): Can someone confirm which deployment modes satisfy EU-only + BYOK? I can prep runbook if Dedicated works.

Lena (Security): Hosted API won't meet EU-only + BYOK. Dedicated (eu-west) or Private are the options. BYOK adds KMS integration steps and subprocessors disclosure. 30-day deletion is stricter than our 60-day default  flag Legal.

Sam (Legal): We normally do 60d. I can propose 45d with certified deletion language and audit rights, but 30d needs exec sign-off. Also they want quarterly subprocessor updates  we'll push for annual unless risk justifies.

Kai (Infra): Technical notes: we support BYOK for Dedicated; customer must provide key endpoint, certs, and rotation plan. eu-west Dedicated adds ~40ms median network delta for US clients. HSM vs cloud-KMS requirement will change onboarding time.

Diego (Onboarding): Drafting two options for the call: 1) Dedicated + BYOK (recommended) with ops checklist; 2) Private VPC for full isolation. I'll include a KMS checklist and timeline.

Maya (CS): Customer needs answers by 09:00 PST. Sam  can Legal accept a 45d compromise for retention and 90d for embeddings?

Sam (Legal): Yes to 45d for exported data and 90d embeddings as long as embeddings are scoped to non-PII or we add extra controls; I'll draft amendment.

Lena (Security): Also ask customer: are embeddings considered PII? That affects retention and access controls.

ops-bot: ops-bot set ticket `dpa-triage:tideflow` status -> awaiting-customer.

Maya (CS): Thanks team  I'll update the thread after the call.
